phase_erasure.generic_constraint_call: monomorphized to sealed direct or sealed invoke before XrProgram
phase_erasure.source_import_call: whole-program link resolves the imported declaration to one canonical FunctionId before XrProgram
phase_erasure.interface_conformance_check: verified compile-time fact; runtime operation exists only when an existential value is formed
phase_erasure.devirtualized_existential_call: optimization of a witness call, guarded by translation validation; canonical semantics remain witness dispatch

canonical_entities.callable_signature: ordered READ/REF/MOVE parameters, result ownership, typed error/panic channels, effects and borrowed-result origins
canonical_entities.callable_value: typed value containing one closed callable target identity and an optional typed capture aggregate
canonical_entities.interface_declaration: stable nominal interface identity plus ordered object-safe witness slots
canonical_entities.conformance: stable nominal implementor identity and kind plus an exact slot-to-function map
canonical_entities.existential_value: typed carrier intent containing one concrete value and one exact conformance identity
canonical_entities.witness_call: dispatch through one verified interface slot; selector, method name and body shape are not operands
canonical_entities.borrowed_result: sorted deduplicated PARAM, RECEIVER and STATIC origin rows owned by the callable signature

operation_atoms.law: call one typed callable value whose signature has no error or panic channel
call one typed callable value and transfer to normal, optional typed-error and optional typed-panic continuations
dispatch one existential receiver through one exact object-safe witness slot with no error or panic channel
dispatch one existential receiver through one exact object-safe witness slot and explicit typed continuations
form one existential value from a concrete value and exact conformance identity
test an existential value against one exact nominal implementor identity
project the concrete value after a dominating successful exact nominal test
form one typed callable value from a closed target identity and optional capture aggregate

explicit_non_operations.source_import: whole-program symbol resolution and identity remap
explicit_non_operations.interface_upcast: existential.pack with a different verified conformance/view identity
explicit_non_operations.devirtualized_call: private VM/AOT optimization of a witness call
explicit_non_operations.selector_or_name_lookup: forbidden; dispatch uses stable interface and slot identity
explicit_non_operations.class_only_itable: forbidden as canonical semantics; carrier lowering is nominal-kind-neutral
explicit_non_operations.borrow_lifetime: signature-owned origin rows and Wave 3 call-bound loan facts
explicit_non_operations.dynamic_unknown_call: forbidden; an unknown target set or signature fails before XrProgram

borrow_origin_contract.source_syntax: returning direct const Slice<T> declares 'from' PARAM, RECEIVER or STATIC origins
borrow_origin_contract.type_identity: sorted and deduplicated (kind, parameter ordinal) set; names, source order, duplicates and elision are excluded
borrow_origin_contract.body_role: verify every actual return root belongs to the signature set; never infer signature authority
borrow_origin_contract.call_mapping: map every formal origin to caller RootIds, recursively expand view actuals, then sort and deduplicate
borrow_origin_contract.xi_evidence: retain only a normalized source recipe; consumers recursively materialize the complete caller-local root set from current SSA operands, with no mutable root cache, and the verifier rejects empty, cyclic or invalid recipes
borrow_origin_contract.program_rows: XrProgram owns function-local dense RootIds independent of SSA ValueIds plus one sorted unique RootId set for every safe view; PARAM ordinals exclude the receiver and call results are verified by formal-origin expansion
borrow_origin_contract.semantic_plan_boundary: legacy scalar SemanticPlan projection fails XR_SEM_0019 for every non-singleton set until program tables land
borrow_origin_contract.compatibility: no scalar origin fields, body-derived fallback, old reader or dual path

program_table_contract.signature_owner: one canonical content-deduplicated SignatureId table shared by functions, callable types and interface slots
program_table_contract.type_rows: nominal aggregate/variant kind, callable SignatureId and existential InterfaceId plus InterfaceUseKind are target-neutral semantic rows
program_table_contract.interface_rows: stable semantic-key order with declaration-ordered object-safe SignatureId slots
program_table_contract.conformance_rows: stable semantic-key order with exact nominal implementor kind, InterfaceId and slot-to-FunctionId mapping
program_table_contract.receiver_substitution: interface slot receiver is existential Self; conformance verification substitutes only receiver TypeId with the exact nominal implementor and requires every other signature fact to match
program_table_contract.canonicality: input type, interface and conformance order cannot change bytes or ProgramId; signature rows are sorted and deduplicated by complete semantic content
program_table_contract.independent_verification: writer validation and artifact semantic verification independently reject a wrong slot target or malformed table
program_table_contract.compatibility: no duplicate function-owned wire signatures, class-only table, selector/name lookup, old reader or dual schema

existential_operation_contract.type_immediate: canonical program TypeId only; no target layout, VM tag or C representation
existential_operation_contract.pack_conformance: derive exactly one conformance from the concrete operand TypeId and result existential InterfaceId
existential_operation_contract.test_identity: compare the carrier's exact nominal TypeId with the TypeId immediate
existential_operation_contract.project_guard: a successful exact existential.test must dominate project on every predecessor path; joins intersect facts
existential_operation_contract.ownership: READ carriers are trivial-copy logical snapshots; REF carriers preserve one typed place and are affine/copy-forbidden borrow tokens; MOVE/OWNED_STORAGE carriers are affine and copy-forbidden; CONSTRAINT_BOUND is not a runtime existential
existential_operation_contract.ref_escape: REF existential is a call-chain-local affine borrow token; parameters and local control flow may carry it, but function results, error types, aggregate fields and variant payloads must reject it
existential_operation_contract.carrier: reference evaluator and VM use execution-lifetime arenas and an owned-storage cell; AOT threads a backend-private execution context and arena-boxes READ/MOVE/OWNED payload snapshots while REF preserves a typed place pointer; no carrier layout is serialized or exposed through BoundaryABI
existential_operation_contract.source_status: pending class, struct, enum, import and dynamic-target producer integration
existential_operation_contract.compatibility: no old reader, erased-object fallback, selector lookup, backend semantic inference or dual operation spelling

witness_operation_contract.slot_immediate: one declaration-ordered slot ordinal interpreted only against the receiver existential InterfaceId; no selector, method name or backend table offset is encoded
witness_operation_contract.signature_authority: the canonical interface slot SignatureId owns parameter modes, result ownership, borrowed-result origins, typed error and panic channels, and effect and capability upper bounds
witness_operation_contract.receiver_capability: READ carriers admit READ receivers; REF carriers admit READ or REF; MOVE carriers admit READ or MOVE; OWNED_STORAGE carriers admit READ, REF or MOVE; READ/MOVE calls materialize a value and REF preserves the exact place
witness_operation_contract.receiver_substitution: conformance validation substitutes only the existential receiver TypeId with the exact nominal implementor TypeId, requires every other structural signature fact to match, and requires implementation effects and capabilities to be subsets of the slot upper bounds
witness_operation_contract.dispatch: the carrier exact ConformanceId selects one validated slot-to-FunctionId row; malformed carrier identity is refused and target bodies are never inspected to recover semantics
witness_operation_contract.direct: witness_direct is admitted only for a slot without error or panic and returns through its typed result
witness_operation_contract.invoke: witness_invoke requires at least one typed error or panic channel and transfers through explicit normal, error and panic successor arguments
witness_operation_contract.executor_realization: reference evaluator and VM resolve the validated FunctionId; portable-C AOT emits a closed ConformanceId switch whose cases directly call the exact typed implementation after unwrapping the receiver
witness_operation_contract.source_status: pending class, struct, enum, import and dynamic-target producer integration
witness_operation_contract.compatibility: no selector lookup, erased universal call ABI, class-only itable, backend semantic inference, old reader or dual operation spelling

callable_operation_contract.signature_authority: the callable TypeId owns one canonical SignatureId containing visible parameter modes, result ownership, borrowed-result origins, typed error and panic channels, and effect and capability upper bounds
callable_operation_contract.target_identity: callable.pack records one closed FunctionId; no symbol name, selector, source expression or backend address is canonical data
callable_operation_contract.capture_shape: a captureless target matches the visible structural signature; a captured target adds exactly one READ receiver whose TypeId is the optional aggregate capture operand; implementation effects and capabilities must be subsets of the visible upper bounds
callable_operation_contract.capture_ownership: capture aggregates are affine explicit-copy owners; callable values are affine explicit-copy owners and cloning recursively copies the typed capture only through core.owner.copy
callable_operation_contract.direct: indirect_direct is admitted only for a callable signature without error or panic and returns through its exact typed result
callable_operation_contract.invoke: indirect_invoke requires at least one typed error or panic channel and transfers through explicit normal, error and panic successor arguments
callable_operation_contract.executor_realization: reference evaluator and VM resolve the validated FunctionId from a private carrier; portable-C AOT emits a closed FunctionId switch whose cases directly call the exact typed target and prepend a typed capture receiver only when required
callable_operation_contract.boundary: callable carrier layout is backend-private and callable values cannot escape as public reference-evaluator or VM outcomes
callable_operation_contract.source_status: pending function-value, closure, import and resolved dynamic-target producer integration
callable_operation_contract.compatibility: no erased argument vector, universal closure ABI, name/selector lookup, backend semantic inference, old reader or dual operation spelling
